data.body: The two force-closes were reopened and remediated properly. Root cause of the close-gate failure: the completion gate's referencing-commit scan reads git log messages only, matching a rebar-ticket trailer or a leading subject token that resolves in the store. The commits carried ADEVX-133 and ADEVX-134 as their first line, which the extractor does pick up, but those keys resolve nowhere because they are a local numbering convention with no Jira binding, so the scan found nothing.
